definitionZh: QLinearProgress Vue 组件显示彩色加载栏。该栏可以具有确定的进度或不确定的动画。
sourceDefinition: The QLinearProgress Vue component displays a colored loading bar. The bar can either have a determinate progress or an indeterminate animation.
